accountManagement.title: Admin accounts
accountManagement.description: Access to the platform admin panel itself - separate from all organization users.
accountManagement.newAdminModalDescription: Creates another access to the platform admin panel.
accountManagement.name: Name

toasts.createFailed: Admin account could not be created
toasts.selfDowngradeConfirm: Set your own account to read-only? You will immediately lose write access to this panel yourself.
toasts.updateFailed: Admin account could not be updated
toasts.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate "{name}"? The account immediately loses access to the platform admin panel.

uploadPipeline.title: File pipeline
uploadPipeline.description: Where files from every upload path (protocol image, gallery, Word import, Abgabebox) currently stand - scan result and origin per file, refreshed every 15 seconds.
uploadPipeline.quarantineDescription: Files currently in quarantine waiting for the virus scan that don't have an entry in the files overview yet (that only happens after a successful scan).

system.title: System status
system.description: State of all containers and of the services hocX depends on. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
system.problemCount: {count, plural, one {# open problem} other {# open problems}}
system.staleSince: The system status is out of date (last updated {time}). Monitoring in the backend is not running.
system.noData: No data yet - monitoring collects on its next run.
system.dockerNotConfigured: The container overview is not set up (DOCKER_API_URL missing, see RUNBOOK).
system.eventsDescription: The last 50 status changes - the same ones that are sent via ntfy.

postgres.detail: {latencyMs, number} ms · {connections, number}/{maxConnections, number} connections · {sizeMb, number} MB

storage.detail: {freePercent, number} % free · {freeGb, number} of {totalGb, number} GB

error_rate.detail: {lastHour, number} in the last hour · {lastDay, number} in 24 h
error_rate.problem: Many entries in the error log

photo_queue.title: Image analysis
photo_queue.problem: Image analysis queue is backing up

monitor.stale: System monitoring is not delivering data

container.memory_high: Container {subject} is almost out of memory

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: All periodic background jobs - when they last ran, how long they took and whether they failed. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
jobs.consecutiveFailures: {count, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}

details.runCounts: {runs, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}, {failures, plural, one {# failed} other {# failed}}

history.title: History
history.description: The most recent runs. For very frequent jobs, only failures and the first success afterwards.

upload_pipeline_rescan.title: Rescan internal uploads
upload_pipeline_rescan.description: Rescans protocol images, gallery uploads and Word imports that could not be virus-scanned at upload time.

abgabebox_rescan.title: Rescan Abgabebox
abgabebox_rescan.description: Rescans Abgabebox files that could not be virus-scanned at upload time and releases clean files.

gallery_upload_ingest.title: Gallery import
gallery_upload_ingest.description: Processes images and ZIP archives from "Upload images": virus scan, thumbnails, storage.

photo_analysis_auto_queue.title: Schedule image analysis
photo_analysis_auto_queue.description: Schedules face detection for new images - only within the configured time window and when server load is low.

photo_quality_backfill.title: Backfill image quality
photo_quality_backfill.description: Computes sharpness and exposure for images that are still missing them.

photo_album_sync.title: Sync albums
photo_album_sync.description: Adds new and removes deleted Abgabebox images in the automatic albums.

photo_analysis_worker.title: Image analysis worker
photo_analysis_worker.description: Separate container that runs scheduled image analyses. Monitored through its heartbeat every few seconds.

domain_health_check.title: Domain check
domain_health_check.description: Checks that tenants' custom domains still point to hocX correctly.

cycle_snapshot.title: Cycle snapshots
cycle_snapshot.description: Automatically creates a table snapshot once a cycle has ended.

log_cleanup.title: Clean up logs
log_cleanup.description: Deletes old audit log, error log and job history entries.

abgabebox_quarantine_cleanup.title: Clean up quarantine
abgabebox_quarantine_cleanup.description: Removes leftover files from the Abgabebox quarantine, e.g. after aborted uploads.

system_monitor.title: System monitoring
system_monitor.description: Collects the state of containers and services and sends notifications when something is wrong.

backup_db.title: Database backup
backup_db.description: Nightly database backup (cron job on the server via scripts/run_job.sh).

cleanup_storage.title: Storage cleanup
cleanup_storage.description: Nightly cleanup of old export files under storage/exports (cron job on the server via scripts/run_job.sh).

task_package_rollover.title: Update task packages
task_package_rollover.description: Daily creates the tasks of the current cycle from all active task packages (the new cycle’s tasks after a cycle change) and adds new recurrences.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts for problems from system status and jobs via ntfy - plus a status endpoint for external monitoring (e.g. Uptime Kuma).
notifications.ntfyDescription: Notifies when a problem appears (after 90 seconds, so deployments don't trigger alerts), gets worse, persists or is resolved.
notifications.tokenSetPlaceholder: Saved - leave empty to keep it
notifications.tokenHelp: Access token (tk_…) or user:password. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
notifications.adminUrlHelp: Optional. Tapping a notification then opens the matching page directly.
notifications.reminderHelp: Notify again about problems that are still open. 0 = no reminders.
notifications.saveBeforeTest: Save first - the test message uses the saved settings.
notifications.statusDescription: Responds with HTTP 200 as long as no critical problem is open, otherwise with 503 - even if monitoring itself is stuck or ntfy is unreachable.
notifications.rotateConfirm: Create a new token? The current URL will stop working - update it in Uptime Kuma.
notifications.statusHelp: Add it in Uptime Kuma as monitor type HTTP(s). Accepted status codes: 200-299. The response only contains counts, no details.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.mfaRequiredTitle: MFA is required for platform admin accounts
login.mfaRequiredDescription: {user} needs a second factor (authenticator app) before logging in.
login.confirmationCodeLabel: Confirmation code from your authenticator app

status.totpSetupStartFailed: TOTP setup could not be started

userManagement.toolbarDescription: All participants across every organization. Each account belongs to exactly one organization.
userManagement.passwordHelpEdit: Only fill in to change the password. At least 12 characters.
userManagement.passwordHelpCreate: Set directly here, at least 12 characters. There is no automatic invitation email - share the password with the participant separately.
userManagement.tenantFixedHelp: An account's organization is fixed and cannot be changed.

tenantModal.title: Organization settings – {tenant}

fields.userLimitHelp: Empty = plan limit applies. Currently {count} user(s){suffix}
fields.showOnWebsite: Show as customer on the website
fields.showOnWebsiteHelp: Appears on the public website under “Used by” (name only). Only enable with the organisation’s consent.

tenantModal.sideNote: The organization sees plan, modules and estimated cost under Organization settings → Plan & usage.

table.name: Name
table.empty: This organization has no users yet.

tenantModal.usersHint: Each account belongs to exactly one organization. Create new users under "Users" and pick the organization there.

cleanup.warning: This action permanently deletes data from the database - there is no undo. The organization itself, templates, form fields and user access stay in any case.
cleanup.allHint: Selects all categories below at once.
cleanup.nothingDeleted: nothing (0 matches in the selected categories)
cleanup.confirmLabel: Type the organization name to confirm: "{name}"
cleanup.confirmMessage: {count} data category/categories of "{tenant}" will be permanently deleted. Continue?

protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.description: All protocols - manually created and imported - including the Word-import queue.

list_entries.title: Data from lists
list_entries.description: All entries in all lists. The lists themselves (name, columns) remain.

lists_full.title: Lists completely
lists_full.description: Lists including their entries. Also deletes Abgabebox configurations linked to one of these lists.

todos.title: Todos
todos.description: Standalone todos. Todos tied to a protocol already disappear with "Protocols".

participants.title: Participants without login
participants.description: Removes participants without login. Participants with login are retained.

documents.title: Uploaded documents
documents.description: Word/PDF imports and Abgabebox uploads, including files orphaned as a result.

storage.noPackagesInCatalog: No storage packages in the catalog.

toasts.storagePackageCatalogLoadFailed: Storage package catalog could not be loaded
toasts.packagesSaveFailed: Storage packages could not be saved
toasts.featureCatalogLoadFailed: Feature catalog could not be loaded
toasts.planCatalogLoadFailed: Plan catalog could not be loaded
toasts.storageLoadFailed: Storage usage could not be loaded
toasts.userDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete user "{name}"? The account belongs only to this organization and will be gone afterwards.

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.description: Unexpected backend errors from the whole application (hocX + Abgabebox) - regular users never see more than a generic message.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: All custom domains across every organization, with status and health check.
domains.deleteConfirmMessage: This domain will be removed from organization "{tenant}". The organization can then set up a new domain and verify it again.

sso.description: Configure external sign-in (SSO) exclusively for logging into the platform admin panel. Organization users are not affected and continue to sign in with a password.

mfa.intro: Platform admin accounts have system-wide access to every organization and therefore require a second factor. At least one factor must always remain.
mfa.mandatoryNote: MFA is mandatory for platform admin accounts.
mfa.passkeysUnavailable: No passkey support in this browser
mfa.totpDescription: A time-based code (TOTP) from an authenticator app such as Bitwarden, 1Password or Google Authenticator.
mfa.passkeyDescription: Unlock via Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key - fast and without typing a code.
mfa.noFactorsYet: No MFA factors set up yet.
mfa.lastFactorNote: The last factor can't be removed.
mfa.lastFactorTitle: Platform administrators must keep at least one MFA factor

tenants.title: Organizations
tenants.description: All organizations in the system. New organizations are created centrally here.
tenants.newTenantDescription: Creates a new organization with the default document template.
tenants.nonBookablePlansHint: Non-bookable plans (e.g. for existing organizations) can be assigned afterwards in the organization settings.
tenants.cloneDescription: Creates a new organization based on this one.
tenants.cloneStructureOnlyDescription: Templates, form fields, document templates, cycles, accounts. No participants, events, protocols or users.
tenants.cloneFullDescription: Also participants, events, protocols, fines, todos, submissions and user access — e.g. for testing.
tenants.exportDescription: Creates a ZIP file to download, which can later be imported again in the admin panel as a new organization. The file contains credentials (password hashes, MFA keys, link and subscription tokens) and must be stored securely.
tenants.exportStructureOnlyDescription: Cycles, form fields, document templates, lists (definition only, no content), accounts, user roles and verified domains (incl. verification code).
tenants.exportStructureListsDescription: As above, plus the entries in the lists. Without participants/events - list entries that reference a participant or event are carried over without that reference.
tenants.exportFullDescription: Also participants, events, protocols, fines, todos, files (incl. photo gallery and albums), share links, calendar subscriptions and album shares. Without Abgabebox.
tenants.exportFullAbgabeboxDescription: As above, plus Abgabebox configuration, Abgabebox links and uploaded files. Complete backup of the organization.
tenants.importDescription: Creates a new organization from a previously exported ZIP file.
tenants.mayTakeAMoment: This may take a moment depending on the file size.
tenants.importNotesDescription: The organization was imported, but some rows were skipped or adjusted:
tenants.deleteConfirmMessage: {participants} participants, {users} user accounts, and all protocols, events and files of this organization will be lost. This cannot be undone.
tenants.importedWithWarnings: {count, plural, one {Organization imported with # note} other {Organization imported with # notes}}

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Plans and modules assigned to organizations. All prices in CHF, excl. VAT.
pricing.nonBookablePlansFootnote: Non-bookable plans don't appear under "New organization", but can be assigned to individual organizations.
pricing.coreFeatureFootnote: Protocols, events, todos, participants and lists are core features included in every plan. Add-ons are booked per organization in the "Plan & subscription" tab of the organization settings.
pricing.storagePackagesFootnote: Add-on packages that organizations can book in addition to their plan quota in the "Storage" tab.
pricing.tenantsCanBookThemselves: Organizations can book this plan themselves.
pricing.onlyAdminCanAssign: This plan can only be assigned by the administration.
pricing.priceHelp: No fixed price? Just leave the fields empty. The monthly price is suggested from the yearly price with a 20% markup.
pricing.storageLimitHelp: The storage limit is applied to organizations as a quota, in addition to any booked storage packages.
pricing.notAssignedToAnyTenant: Not assigned to any organization yet.
pricing.name: Name
pricing.addonPriceHelp: Empty = not bookable as an add-on, only bundled via a plan.
pricing.packageSaveFailed: Storage package could not be saved
pricing.featuredOnWebsite: Highlight as “Most popular” on the website
pricing.featuredOnWebsiteHelp: At most one plan – saving removes the highlight from all other plans. Only bookable plans appear on the website.
pricing.reloadFailed: Could not reload the price catalog.
pricing.packageNotBookableHelp: Can no longer be added. Existing assignments remain and appear under "Rebook".

catalogImport.title: Import configuration
catalogImport.description: Upload a JSON file with modules, plans and storage packages. You will see all changes before anything is saved.
catalogImport.fileHelp: Easiest: download the current configuration, edit it and upload it again. The file contains instructions.
catalogImport.invalidJson: The file is not a valid JSON object.
catalogImport.mergeHelp: Off: only the entries and fields in the file are created or changed, everything else stays.
catalogImport.overwriteHelp: On: the catalog is replaced by the file. Missing plans and packages are deleted, or set to not bookable if they are still assigned to organizations.
catalogImport.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} in the file. Please fix and upload again.
catalogImport.noChanges: No changes: the file matches the current catalog.
catalogImport.tenantCount: {count, plural, one {# organization affected} other {# organizations affected}}
catalogImport.applied: Import applied: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}.
catalogImport.confirmMessage: {deleted, plural, =0 {Nothing will be deleted} one {# entry will be deleted} other {# entries will be deleted}}, {deactivated, plural, =0 {nothing will be set to not bookable} one {# entry will be set to not bookable} other {# entries will be set to not bookable}}. Affected organizations are listed under "Rebook" afterwards.

catalogRebooking.empty: All organizations only have bookable plans and packages.
catalogRebooking.footnote: Organizations on a plan or with a storage package that is not bookable (highlighted). "Rebook" opens the organization's settings: change the plan in the "Plan & subscription" tab and packages in the "Storage" tab.
